text:
Which statement defines the term molecular formula?
A
a formula that shows the total number of atoms in a molecule
B
a formula that shows the total number of elements in a molecule
C
a formula that shows the arrangement of different atoms in a molecule
D
a formula that shows the number and type of different atoms in a molecule

options.label: A
options.text: a formula that shows the total number of atoms in a molecule

options.label: B
options.text: a formula that shows the total number of elements in a molecule

options.label: C
options.text: a formula that shows the arrangement of different atoms in a molecule

options.label: D
options.text: a formula that shows the number and type of different atoms in a molecule
